params.label_rule: surface result: depth_m <= 1.0 m, or depth unknown; a result flagged 'bottom' is never a surface result, at any depth; Secchi exempt (sentinel.data.matchups.wqp_surface_samples, unchanged). Results come from the harmonised, QC-passed wqp_discrete tables only (variable=*/); rows of _qc_rejects.parquet and _unmapped.parquet never contribute. Sample label: median of those results over (site_id, date, target, characteristic, unit). A sample without such a result is dropped (reason no_qc_passed_result or no_surface_result).
